Maxio._comment: Maxio Advanced Billing. ApiKey is secret and must come from user-secrets or the Maxio__ApiKey environment variable - never from this file. BaseUrl is the configurable outbound target: leave it empty to derive the host from Subdomain and Environment, or set it to point this same build at production, a dev tenant, or a local mock server. Environment is the Maxio data-center region (US or EU), not the deployment target.
